description: Comprehensive accommodations for students with physical disabilities affecting mobility or dexterity
specific_accommodations: Provision of note-taking services or recording devices
50% additional time on all exams and timed assessments
Use of adaptive technology (voice-to-text, ergonomic equipment)
Early registration for accessible class locations
Alternative format for written assignments (oral presentations, video submissions)
notes: Coordinate with facilities management for classroom accessibility. May require specialized equipment procurement.
